notes.title: MAF Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone for your feedback while our team worked on fixing some aspects of MAF! We have a small update to discuss, so let's go over it. ːsteamhappyː
Changes
Steam achievements are re-enabled and should trigger correctly

Does not apply to current saves, so thresholds will have to be triggered again.

Modified the animations for some crops to be less jarring

Enemies now spawn after many rounds

The ranged stat items now properly change attack range of weapons

Previously, this just modified the lifetime of player projectiles. Now this also applies to target acquisition range.

This is mainly applicable to the carrot item.

Fade In/Out between loading zones

Added green particle effects when the player regens health through the health regen stat

Added SFX to encyclopedia

As always, please continue to post any improvement, recommendations, or bugs to Steam. We'll keep an eye out and fix things as they come up!



MAF

notes.title: MAF Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, apologies for breaking things! This hotfix fixes the load issue from the combat level back to the farm! 



There may potentially be issues with steam achievements, we are looking into the issue and we'll get a fix out asap!



Fixes:
- Loading from death screen in combat level to farm now works properly

Known Bugs:
- The issue was caused by a backend issue with Steam Achievements. The fix may cause some achievements to not unlock properly.

notes.title: Patch 1.0 - End of Early Access
notes.content:
Thank you to all who tested the game early and gave feedback! It moves us greatly to know that even a small project can bring a lot of joy! ːsteamhappyːNow, for the real dill...
Major Changes
Steam achievements added

There seven achievements in total:

[/td][/tr][/table]
Farming Fields added to the farm

Seeds drop during combat defeating certain enemies.

Plant seeds in given farm fields to grow them. Every round played advances their growth stage by one. Harvesting finished crops yields a one time use buff that grants strong bonuses. See if you can try them all!

Crops added:

[/td][td]

[/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="94"]

[/td][td]
Reflects the last enemy attack that hits back. Melee is an all around AoE. Ranged is a circle of projectiles. Cool-down of 5 seconds.

Protective hat. Provides 5 extra armor and after the player receives more than 10% of their max health, heal a small amount.
[/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="94"]

After taking melee damage, player gains 10% attack speed for 5 seconds. Stacks up to 8 times. Last 5 seconds. Stack can be gained every second.
[/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="94"]

[/td][td]

[/td][/tr][/table]
There are multiple farm plots that a player can have. One is given upon completing a round, the rest can be bought with hay.
Small Changes
When crops are consumed, they are added to the player HUD and inventory screens to indicate they are active in combat.

Speed of panther and small cat have been reduced. [strike]Yay! Less suffering![/strike]

Base drop amount of hay have been doubled. Rate of increase is the same per wave.

Sword icon in weapon selection has been updated.

Various UI tweaks for the farm and various shops.

Adjusted attack speed upgrades to be more impactful.

Chaos box now indicates what stat is impacted in the pause menu within combat.

Enemy damage indicators adjusted.

Settings save correctly when adjusted.

Music now replays after first completing.
Known Bugs ːsteammockingː
Sword attack speed varying upon first launch. 

As always, if you find additional bugs within the game, report them on on Steam page or community section. Feedback greatly helps improve the game!



For further development, we plan on fixes a few bugs as found. Development will be put on hold while our team winds down and focuses on new projects. Follow our social media to keep up to date!
